newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi aide unworried about quorum for Italy budget.
newsitem.headline: Prodi aide unworried about quorum for Italy budget.

text.p: The undersecretary to the Prime Minister said on Monday the centre-right Freedom Alliance and separatist Northern League parties' decision not to take part in voting on the 1997 budget made the budget process "difficult."
But undersecretary Enrico Micheli said he was not worried about the legal quota needed in the Chamber of Deputies or lower house to approve the budget legislation.
"The situation is not good, it's complicated and difficult... but there are no worries for the quorum," Micheli told reporters in parliament.

"We hope there is still room for reasonableness and we hope that the meeting which (Prime Minister Romano) Prodi has requested with (Freedom Alliance leader Silvio) Berlusconi can take place," he said.
